Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator wrote a flawed Python script with placeholder traversal (moving straight down by +2 each turn) instead of computing a valid path toward END while avoiding blue cells. It also mishandled Excel color parsing (treating ARGB as RGB and using a naive “blue” check), and even pointed to the wrong file path. These errors led to deriving the wrong landing cell and reporting 000000 instead of the correct F478A7.
